patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Pro features, taals, variations, scales, Manjeera, Tanpuras, removes purchase banners and ads.

patches_added.name: Block marketing notifications
patches_added.description: Blocks promotional and marketing notification prompts and modals.

patches_added.name: Disable Facebook SDK
patches_added.description: Disables Facebook SDK initialization, marketing, and ad network activity.

patches_added.name: Disable Play Integrity
patches_added.description: Bypasses Google Play Integrity API checks.

patches_added.name: Disable telemetry
patches_added.description: Disables AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Adjust telemetry.

patches_added.name: Enable Premium
patches_added.description: Unlocks AI insights and premium features locked behind subscription.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables banner, interstitial, feed, native, preroll and rewarded ads.

patches_added.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_added.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches_added.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_added.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_added.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_added.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches_added.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_added.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.

patches_added.name: Download pin from long press
patches_added.description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches_added.name: Hide ad views
patches_added.description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.

patches_added.name: Morphe runtime names
patches_added.description: Resolves the class Pinterest builds its toasts with, so Morphe's messages look like the app's own.

patches_added.name: Sanitize copied links
patches_added.description: Turns the pin.it link that "Copy link" copies, whose slug identifies who shared it, into the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_added.name: Sanitize shared links
patches_added.description: Strips tracking parameters from the link on the Android share sheet and resolves pin.it short links to the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, both switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces "limit ad tracking", without crashing the app.

patches_modified.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Set as wallpaper" option to the pin menu, which downloads the image and sets it as the device wallpaper.
